retrievalProfile.description: A dense, maximalist analog collage featuring hand-cut photographs layered with visible paper edges and varying scales to create a nostalgic, scrapbook-style montage.
excludeWhen: minimalist layouts with significant white space

recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic yet cohesive assembly of various photographs, primarily portraits, that are physically cut out and layered on top of one another. The style mimics a physical scrapbook where images overlap without borders, creating a dense tapestry of memories with varying focal lengths, lighting conditions, and grain textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Dense overlapping of subjects to eliminate background space
Juxtaposition of childhood and adult portraits of the same subject
Varying scales of figures creating a non-linear depth
Visible hand-cut edges suggesting a physical, tactile origin
Interlocking shapes where one figure's outline defines the frame for another
coreInvariants: Total coverage of the canvas with no visible base substrate
Inconsistent lighting and color grading between individual photo elements
Sharp, scissor-cut edges on foreground elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple subjects of varying sizes; larger portraits often anchor the corners or center while smaller figures fill the gaps.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central figure or a large, high-contrast portrait usually serves as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular and erratic; the eye jumps between faces and pops of color (like red clothing or yellow balloons) across the entire frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: None; the composition is intentionally crowded to evoke a sense of overwhelming nostalgia.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted, naturalistic skin tones and varied clothing colors from disparate photos.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Primary colors like bold reds and yellows found in specific clothing or props.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Desaturated greens and blues from outdoor backgrounds within the cutouts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High variance; some photos are high-contrast and saturated while others are faded and grainy, typical of different film eras.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid uniform color grading across the whole image

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense collage of various portraits and candid photos. Use a mix of childhood and adult subjects. Ensure images are 'cut out' with sharp edges and layered heavily so no background is visible. Include varied textures like 35mm film grain and slightly faded polaroid colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, apply it as if it were a physical sticker or a hand-written label on top of the finished collage.

verificationChecks: Is the entire canvas covered with overlapping photos?
Are there visible 'cut' edges on the top layers?
Is there a mix of different photo qualities and lighting?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of childhood to adult photos
Frequency of 'pop' colors like red or yellow
mustRedesign: Uniform borders or frames around photos

mustAchieve: Complex layering that creates a sense of depth
Variety in photo subjects and scales

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'floating' elements that don't feel integrated into the stack
Ensure no single photo dominates more than 25% of the frame
Verify that edges look like physical paper cuts rather than digital masks
Confirm a variety of focal lengths are represented
recipe.reuseFormula: Layer [Subject Type] photos of varying [Age/Era] using a [Hand-cut/Scrapbook] technique to create a [Maximalist/Dense] composition with [Primary Color] accents.
